description: Check an InterProScan job started by interpro_scan_sequence, waiting up to waitSeconds for it to finish. Returns the matches once finished, otherwise its queued or running status to check again later. Matches are InterProScan records verbatim, 1-based and inclusive, with the InterPro and InterProScan versions that produced them. Jobs and their results expire seven days after submission.

cursor.description: Opaque coverage.nextCursor from an earlier result for this same jobId, to read the next segment.

jobId.description: jobId returned by interpro_scan_sequence, such as iprscan6-R20261028-131532-0930-13189043-p1m.

waitSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for a pending job to finish; 0 checks its status once and returns.

name: interpro_get_scan_result

coverage.description: Where this segment sits in the complete match list; present when finished.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next segment; pass it unchanged to the tool the notice names.

offset.description: Match records that precede this segment.

totalMatches.description: Match records in the complete result.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_cursor`: The cursor is malformed, belongs to another job, or no longer fits the result. `scan_failed`: The InterProScan job ended with status ERROR or FAILURE. `scan_not_found`: The Job Dispatcher has no such job: it never existed or expired after seven days. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: Polling and result reading exhausted the fifty-second call budget. `upstream_shape_invalid`: The Job Dispatcher returned a response this server cannot read. `upstream_response_too_large`: The job result exceeds 4 MiB. `upstream_rejected`: The Job Dispatcher returned an unhandled redirect or client rejection. `upstream_unavailable`: The Job Dispatcher had a network or server failure. `upstream_timeout`: A Job Dispatcher request returned HTTP 408/504 or exceeded its attempt deadline. `upstream_rate_limited`: The Job Dispatcher returned HTTP 429. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

interproVersion.description: InterPro release of a finished InterProScan job.

interproscanVersion.description: InterProScan version of a finished job.

jobId.description: InterProScan job ID on the interproscan path; results stay retrievable for seven days.

matches.description: Whole match records in this segment when finished, sorted by earliest location start then signature accession; coordinates are 1-based and inclusive. Each record keeps its own source and signatureLibraryRelease.

items.description: One match location with every upstream field, such as scores, e-values, HMM bounds, envelope, sites, and alignments.
One continuous piece of a possibly discontinuous match location.

dc-status.description: Discontinuity status, such as CONTINUOUS, N_TERMINAL_DISC, or C_TERMINAL_DISC.

signature.description: Matched signature, including name, description, and type when supplied.

accession.description: Member-database signature accession, such as PF13499.

entry.description: InterPro entry the signature is integrated into; null when unintegrated.

signatureLibraryRelease.description: Library and release of this signature.

library.description: Member database name exactly as the source spells it, such as Pfam.

version.description: Member database release that produced this match.

source.description: Method that produced the match, such as Pfam or InterPro-N, exactly as the source spells it.

md5.description: Uppercase hex MD5 of the uppercased residues, the UniParc sequence digest.

source.description: Which path produced the result: precalculated matches from the InterPro Matches API, or an InterProScan 6 job run through the EBI Job Dispatcher.

sourceUrl.description: Upstream endpoint that supplied this result.

status.description: finished: matches are present. queued or running: the job is pending; read it later with interpro_get_scan_result. submitted: accepted in this call and not yet polled.

totalCount.description: Match records in the complete result.

title: Read an InterProScan job
